note: Strengths follow the reviewed secondary synthesis in World History Encyclopedia. It estimates 9,000 Athenian and 1,000 Plataean hoplites, and 20,000–25,000 Persian fighting infantry; the Persian midpoint is used for display. Possible cavalry is not assigned a formation. Herodotus reports 192 Athenian and about 6,400 foreign dead; the latter cannot be split between Persian troop types. Ancient figures remain uncertain. The Persian equipment is a contemporary analogy, not a verified uniform.
